name: Navi Mumbai International Airport, Ulwe
description: Runway and terminal built on an already graded airport platform between 2021 and 2025. Public EC/CRZ records exist; the registered platform outline is illustrative.

sources.title: NMIA Environmental & CRZ compliance report, April–September 2025

replay.note: AUTHORISED_ACTIVITY expected from inspected pair; This pair demonstrates building on prepared land, not the original hill removal or mangrove reclamation. Wetland changes outside the airport platform must be judged separately. The old and renewed clearance have separate registry periods.
